queries: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the average of bandusagepct across all telescope rows with non-null values (telescope-weighted), as the request states; stations whose telescopes all have null usage are excluded.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

responses.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandusagepct, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of bandusagepct over all telescope rows with non-null values (telescope-weighted), as the request states, not the mean of station averages.
Stations are taken from the telescopes table; stations with no telescopes or only NULL bandwidth values are excluded.

responses.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth, s.avg_bandwidth - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is computed over all telescope rows with non-null bandusagepct, so stations with more telescopes weigh more, as the request states. Stations with no non-null values are excluded.
